decisions.D-620: Inbound envelope is an ordered parts list; text is just a part
decisions.D-621: arcagent translates a workspace MediaPart into a content block at its own boundary, reaching types through the arcrun facade; arcgateway never imports arcllm
decisions.D-622: Adapters are in-tree arcgateway/adapters/<name>/ modules discovered by directory scan against a declared PLATFORM contract; a deleted folder is unnoticed, a failed import is skipped and logged
decisions.D-623: An inbound message always lands in the session and the agent handles it; steer-vs-follow-up-vs-start is internal to arcagent and 'interrupt' leaves the gateway-facing seam entirely
decisions.D-624: Gateway writes inbound media to the agent workspace with direct I/O (ADR-029) and passes a MediaPart ref; session history holds the ref, bytes are materialised only for the provider call that needs them
decisions.D-625: Collapse pairing's four files into one module with one entry point, preserving every property (hashed ids, operator approval, throttle); session/runner/web untouched this pass
decisions.D-626: A paired channel IS the authorization boundary: inbound media from Slack/Telegram/operator-token arcui does not trip the lethal-trifecta human gate per file. Trust attaches to the channel, not to each artefact
decisions.D-627: The gateway names the file, not the sender: workspace/inbox/<date>/<hhmmss>-<sender>-<sanitised-stem>.<ext>, sender derived from the resolved user_did. Original filename kept as metadata. Size capped against accident; one media.received audit event per file (AU pillar is universal)
decisions.D-678: arcgateway owns session identity (build_session_key / router.new_session); arcui and arctui are viewpoints that call it. Rotation only on explicit /new
decisions.D-679: Injection targets the INTERACTIVE run only; a background run (scheduler, pulse, consolidation) is never an injection target. No interactive run = new turn in the same session [refines D-671]

locked_decisions: Adapters become in-tree optional modules of arcgateway, not separate packages (user directive)
Gateway never imports arcllm (user directive, CLAUDE.md line 23)
open_questions: session_queue.py becomes vestigial under D-623 unless it earns its keep as flood backpressure — decide before implementing, do not leave dead code (CLAUDE.md 3).
Verify session_key stability per channel in arcui — 'never a new session' depends on it.
Deferred: Anthropic Files API (file_id) for media referenced across several turns — an arcllm capability.
arcui Messages needs a NATS broker; test with a mock backend, assume up on DGX.
notes: Final ID range D-668 to D-679, appended to .claude/decisions-log.md and validated.

Diagnosis corrected: the reported 'new session each time' is a new RUN in a stable session, caused by nothing calling deliver_message. arcui was never a source of session instability — it already delegates to the gateway.
